document.abstract: A new higher-speed color reversal 16mm film compatible with Process VNF-1 is now available. The film, Eastman Ektachrome video news film high speed 7250 (tungsten), has been developed to further satisfy the needs of the television news industry and other 16mm motion-picture needs for low-light photography. It offers an increased capability of recording, for broadcast purposes, of scenes at very low light levels determined according to the TEMS (Terminal Exposure Modulated Scene) concept of exposure or the “ideal” exposure method. The new film is a companion for two other video-news-film products — Eastman Ektachrome video news film 7239 (daylight) and Eastman Ektachome video news film 7240 (tungsten).
